description_en: Queries the intelligent alert events for vehicle operations
description_zh: 调用该接口查询车辆作业的智能告警事件列表
name: QueryCarProcessEvents

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the instance does not have an ID<props="intl"><ph> or the Instance Overview page is not displayed</ph></props>, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IP camera (IPC) device. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and uniquely identifies the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation of IoT Platform to query the ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. The IotId uniquely identifies the device and corresponds to the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: sub_iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to query the information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: sub_product_key

parameters.help_en:

You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>

EventTime.description_zh: 事件发生的时间戳，单位为毫秒

EventType.description_en:
The type of the intelligent alert event. Valid values:

0: All intelligent alert events.
Multiple intelligent alert events: Enter the sequence numbers of the intelligent alert events and separate them with commas (,), such as `10001,10002`.
You can specify up to 10 intelligent alert events at a time.

To view all intelligent alert event types, go to the Define Feature tab of the Product Details page in the IoT Platform console. For more information, see [View intelligent alert event types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207701.html）
EventType.description_zh:
智能告警事件类型：

设置为全部智能告警事件：0。
设置为多个智能告警事件：输入智能告警事件对应的序号，并用英文逗号（,）分隔，例如：`10001,10002`。
设置多个智能告警事件时，单次最多支持设置10个。

请在物联网平台控制台，产品详情页面的功能定义页签，查看全部智能告警事件类型。详细信息，请参考[查看智能告警事件类型]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207701.html）
